name: Erlan Tetteh-Yıldırım
role: Bootleg media seller and fortune seller, The Alban Souk
description:
Erlan Tetteh-Yıldırım is wiry and restless, with sandy-brown skin, a scatter of darker freckles across his nose, and color-changing hair he keeps medium-length — today it's cycling slowly between deep indigo and a burnt copper, a gradient that shifts with his mood in a way he has customized to be slightly out of sync with his actual emotional state, because he thinks it's funny to make people misread him. His stall is a folding table, a battered data-terminal with a cracked screen, and a rack of physical media chips he sells alongside what he calls 'experience cartridges' — bootleg sensory recordings, contraband dreamscapes, illegally ripped Ringo entertainment contracts.

The fortune-telling is a sideline and a passion both: he reads data-patterns using a divination system he invented himself, combining traditional nazar iconography from one branch of his heritage with Akan adinkra symbols from the other, mapped onto a set of thirty-two hand-etched chips he calls his 'throw.' He has a gift for it — or at least a gift for reading people well enough that what he says resonates — and a small devoted clientele who come specifically for the throw and don't buy media at all. He is young enough to find everything amusing and old enough to be annoyed by how often that gets mistaken for shallowness. He is sharper than he presents, and he knows exactly how useful that gap is.

core_fears: Being ordinary — not leaving any mark on the city or the people in it
Ringo actually finding the relay node and tracing it back to him
core_desires: To make something original — the fortune system is his, but he wants to build something bigger that is undeniably his
To be taken seriously without having to give up the performance of not caring about being taken seriously
coping_mechanisms: The fortune-throw as a way of processing situations he can't control — reads his own throws compulsively
Keeping everything light and surface-level until the moment he doesn't
blind_spots: Underestimates how much his media operation exposes him — treats it as victimless when the contracts he's violating belong to a corponation that employs a compliance division
Reads others well but applies his read too fast and too confidently, sometimes missing updates
psychology.secret: One of his experience cartridges — a dreamscape he sells as a bootleg Ringo luxury product — is not ripped from Ringo at all. He made it himself, a recording of his own dreams processed through a consumer psych-editor. He is terrified someone will figure out how personal it is and equally terrified they won't.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, layered with media slang and souk vernacular. Shifts registers constantly — can sound like a barker, an academic, or a mystic within one conversation.
speech_patterns.cadence: Quick and rhythmic in sales mode, deliberately slow and careful when doing a fortune reading — the contrast is part of the performance.
verbal_tics: 'Look—' as a sentence opener when he's being serious
Narrates his own fortune throws out loud as he does them, like commentary
example_lines: 'I have twelve versions of that show, three of which are actually good, and one of which will ruin your life in a beautiful way. Tell me what you're looking for and I'll tell you which one.'
'The throw doesn't tell me what will happen. It tells me what you already know that you're pretending you don't. That's usually enough.'

story_hooks: One of the experience cartridges in his current stock contains footage that is definitely not a commercial dreamscape — it appears to be a real recording of something happening in a Palladian facility, spliced into entertainment packaging, and someone is looking for it.
A Ringo compliance agent has been seen asking about him in the Alban Souk. He needs to find out if they have traced the relay or if this is about something else entirely.
narrative_function: Information broker via media — knows what illegal content is circulating and what's in it. Fortune-teller can serve as a narrative mirror or cryptic guide. Young, networked, underestimated — useful for rumors and youth-faction dynamics in Mexicantown Libre.
augmentations: Color-changing geneware hair (custom tuned to be slightly out of sync with emotional state). Retractable cat claws — cosmetic geneware, not sharp enough to be a real weapon, mostly used for emphasis when gesturing.
daily_life: Sets up at the Alban Souk around noon, sells media and readings until late evening. Spends mornings sourcing new content from a pirate relay node he pays a monthly fee to access.
affiliation: Independent; informal with Ringo subsidiary resellers network (he is very much not supposed to be selling their product this way); pays a small pitch fee to the Alban Souk collective

decision_rules: Never sell an experience cartridge to someone who seems dissociative — he has a checklist in his head and he runs it
Keep the fortune-throw separate from the sales patter — he will not use it to manipulate a sale
Always know the nearest two exit routes from wherever he is setting up
escalation_ladder: Invoke the souk collective's pitch-fee protection implicitly
Disappear into the crowd — he is good at this

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Performing charm and accessibility — warm surface, watching underneath
interpersonal_modes.friends: Drops the performance almost entirely, becomes quieter, shows genuine enthusiasms that don't fit the persona at all

stress_responses.low: Performs harder — more jokes, faster patter
stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet in a way that reads as sulky but is actually him thinking very fast
stress_responses.high: Acts immediately and decisively — all the deliberation happens in the quiet phase, the high-stress response is pure kinetic action

contradictions: Sells other people's dreams for money while secretly having made his own dreamscape — which he prices the same as the stolen ones
Claims total cynicism about fortune-telling while privately believing in it deeply enough that a bad self-throw ruins his whole week
habits: Does a self-throw every morning before going to the souk
Reorganizes the chip rack by a system that changes weekly and only he understands
Leaves a small data offering on the cracked terminal for the E.L.F. he calls the Bright Noise — a prayer for good content and no compliance agents
breaking_points: Someone experiencing a psychotic break from one of his cartridges — he has a protocol ready because he has thought about it
The dreamscape cartridge being identified as his — exposure of the personal thing underneath the performance
The relay node going dark and taking his income with it
